title: version-floor proof-transfer false-closes an opt-in/config-gated engine fix — the adopter finding auto-closes on engine>=X while the field repro still reproduces because the adopter hasn't configured the new capability
detail: Proof-transfer closes an adopter finding on a version-floor when the fix has a moat-finding marker + is in _closures.json. That is CORRECT for an engine-only fix (a parser/gate fix takes effect the moment the engine ships). It is a FALSE-CLOSE for a fix that ships a CAPABILITY requiring adopter opt-in (a config flag / declared list): the moat test proves 'engine can when configured', not 'the adopter repro passes', so engine>=X closes the ticket while the field gap persists until the adopter opts in. Concrete: a ui-e2e-check config option shipped, its adopter finding version-floor-closed, but the adopter never declared the config so the under-match still reproduces. Fix (sustainable): a distinct moat-capability: marker for opt-in-gated fixes, DELIBERATELY excluded from _closures.json (changelog.scan_capability_markers), so such findings never version-floor-close — they close on the adopter's own real verify. Guard test pins the invariant capability_ids INTERSECT _closures.json == empty, so the class can't recur.
repro: tag an opt-in-gated fix's adopter finding with moat-finding: + regen → it enters _closures.json → prusik update version-floor-closes it though the adopter never configured the capability

resolution.verify: CUR=$(prusik --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' '0.219.0' "$CUR" | sort -V | head -1)" = '0.219.0' ] && echo "1 passed: engine carries moat-proven fix fb-33e4be4542ff (prusik $CUR >= 0.219.0)"
